0022600143.text: The Clippers (1-2, 1-0 at home) host the Lakers (3-1) in a game that finds Los Angeles 9th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, while the Lakers sit 1st in the Pacific and 5th in the West. The Clippers arrive on a two-game losing streak, the Lakers on a one-game skid, and the Clippers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 125-117 loss in Los Angeles on October 23, following a 2-2 split in 2025-26. Out for the Clippers are Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Jordan Miller, Max Strus, Rui Hachimura and Yanic Konan Niederhauser, and out for the Lakers are Adou Thiero, Cameron Carr, Luka Doncic and Ziaire Williams.
